title: A payment refusal answers PaymentErrorResponse: {"error": {"code": <int>, "message": <string>}}, the one error schema the document names

source.note: PaymentErrorResponse is the only error schema in the 373 components of api-2026-07.yaml: `error` is an OBJECT requiring an integer `code` and a string `message`. This case asserts that SHAPE and nothing about the code's value -- `code` is declared "type: integer" with no enum, no example and no range, the documentation site has no error-codes page, so every code this unit sends is JUDGMENT and lives in one table (lightspeed/model/error.py PaymentErrorCode). The status is JUDGMENT too: the schema carries none, and a closed register is the conflict this unit's error table gives an invalid transition. The rule it enforces is the register:open scope's own wording, "Open a register to create sales and payments".

steps.name: a payment taken at a closed register is refused in the declared shape
